acceptance_owner_definitions.builder: The implementing agent owns objective routine acceptance, fixes failures before handoff, and may pass the gate with deterministic and target-build evidence.
acceptance_owner_definitions.independent: A person or genuinely separate evaluation context that did not build the flow must supply the final gate verdict after builder-owned QA passes.
acceptance_owner_definitions.human: A human perceptual signoff explicitly required by the gate is necessary; automated or structural evidence is supporting only.
acceptance_owner_definitions.provider: An external store, platform, service, certification process, or authorized account owner supplies the final observation after the builder prepares and verifies the exact candidate.
acceptance_owner_definitions.product_owner: The user or explicitly identified product owner decides whether a representative playable concept/visual direction should be multiplied, revised, waived, or closed after routine builder QA passes.

optional_user_preference_policy: User preference feedback may refine taste after blocking acceptance passes, but routine defects must not be deferred to the user unless the brief explicitly makes that preference an acceptance requirement. Product-owner approval of an open-ended complete-game concept before bulk authoring is a separate material product decision, not optional defect discovery.

responsibility_status_policy.builder_work_remaining: Continue autonomously; do not hand off a repair or QA checklist.
responsibility_status_policy.ready_for_human_test: All available and authorized builder-owned work passes on the exact candidate, honest pre-external dimension scores meet every matching external-gate cap, no known external-review failure remains unfixed, and only genuinely external evidence is pending.
responsibility_status_policy.publication_certified: The exact candidate passes all builder, independent, human, provider, product-owner, quality-floor, and publication gates.
responsibility_status_policy.project_closed_user_rejected: The user/product owner explicitly closed the project. Preserve the failure packet, claim neither READY nor publication, stop work, and resume only after a new explicit user instruction.

blocking_gates.description: The supported Godot version imports and runs the evaluated state without relevant errors.
The requested core interaction and completion/progression state can be reached.
The evaluated flow has the required restart, retry, recovery, or repeat path without a soft lock.
Ordinary persistent composition is saved as editable Godot scenes/resources rather than hidden in runtime construction.
External/generated assets used in the evaluated result have sufficient provenance and rights status for the intended test.

Before bulk visual production, a builder-owned record classifies the direction as user-fixed, constraint-determined, or materially ambiguous; preserves explicit user references/exclusions; records a layered style and source contract; compares serious same-content candidates when ambiguity is material or explains truthfully why alternatives do not apply; rejects hard gameplay/rights/platform/tool/scope mismatches; and resolves taste, identity, paid-cost, or major scope choices. Raw Godot gameplay-size hero/style-anchor and representative composition evidence proves the selected route can support its environment, interaction/objective, lighting/material, and material UI/VFX layers. An available pack, fashionable label, generator default, moodboard, or isolated source preview does not pass.

For every production character expected to move in the case, builder-owned deterministic and target-build evidence proves required idle, locomotion, and brief-required context states on the production visual; ordinary play does not remain in bind/rest/T-pose; real gameplay dispatches the states; source mannequins are absent; and required bone/socket/marker attachments follow. Static screenshots, clip presence, preview-rig playback, test-only direct calls, or waiting for the user to notice frozen motion do not pass.

From the raw clean shipping frame, an uncoached player notices that guidance exists, visually binds the required input to its target, performs every brief-required transition, reads immediate feedback and consequence, and reaches the normal loop. If the player does not discover the tutorial or cannot tell what to act on, the gate fails even when localized labels, tutorial variables, or state-machine transitions exist. Static hints, narration, one generic action, and a first teaching state that deliberately drives the player near failure do not pass; ordinary pressure remains frozen or forgiving until the relevant teaching succeeds unless uncoached evidence proves pressure itself is safely taught.

After the final builder run, a release-like clean profile proves shipping-default progress/settings/onboarding separately from seeded QA state in the exact modality the independent/product-owner reviewer will launch. Browser automation storage does not cover Godot Editor Run or an exported app; the real user:// or application-data primary plus backup/recovery envelope is reset and verified so it cannot silently restore completed progress or tutorial flags.

The app/export icon and main-menu mark receive a blind independent semantic review from raw captures at actual final sizes: the reviewer can describe a game-specific subject, relationship, or core-loop cue without designer narration; palette consistency, initials, symmetry, or tidy primitive geometry alone do not pass.

A person or genuinely independent evaluation context that did not build the flow reviews tutorial discoverability and first-use playability plus raw target-build menu, settings, normal gameplay, dense interaction/VFX, and result evidence. The review explicitly rejects text-first/repeated-labeled-rectangle surfaces, native/default-looking controls, unclear core-action telegraphs, and progression copy that lacks visual current/next/cost/consequence meaning; it also covers player occlusion/restoration for third-person work and gameplay-size art/readability/density states for fixed-camera isometric work. Self-review alone does not pass.

One independent blind-first review compares the same exact candidate's main menu, pause/runtime modal, settings, ordinary HUD/core play, result/failure, text-heaviest secondary surface, and critical icon family. It judges cross-surface hierarchy, typography, repeated card/rectangle burden, custom-widget craft, state clarity, optical visible-pixel alignment/padding/weight, and icon-family coherence. Authored/custom nodes, shared colors, equal TextureRects, mathematical centers, or a polished menu cannot cover an unfinished pause/result/settings/map. Expected meanings and the builder verdict remain hidden until first-read observations are locked.

For every locale, an independent reviewer sees raw menu, pause/runtime-modal, and result/failure actions without implementation notes and predicts the exact effect plus progress retention/loss: resume, restart/retry, new save/game, next/continue, return, purchase, discard, or exit. Atmospheric synonyms fail when they obscure the standard action, when copy and icon predict different outcomes, or when the primary action contradicts the surrounding result message.

An independent same-frame review compares world actors/objects, UI/icons, telegraphs/tutorial cues/threats, and VFX for perspective, edge treatment, texture density, scale, optical weight, material/motion language, contact, anchor and depth. Palette agreement alone cannot pass painterly/generated world art crossed by foreign flat strips, thin wireframes, detached arrows/rings, unanchored smudges, or unrelated sharp VFX symbols; normal, dense contact/telegraph and peak consequence states must belong together.

For an open-ended new complete game, the product owner plays or watches an exact representative slice after routine builder QA and before bulk levels/chapters/progression/assets. The record locks the slice and content scale, then captures explicit owner APPROVE or WAIVE; REVISE returns scoped work and CLOSE records project_disposition=user_closed. Initial idea selection, silence, an agent-side independent PASS, or already-authored bulk content cannot substitute for post-play owner authorization of the core loop/concept and visual direction.

A human listener signs off several minutes of representative target-build gameplay audio, overlaps/repetition, UI, pressure/result, transitions, pause/focus, and mixer settings; structural nodes, streams, buses, waveforms, metrics, provenance, or builder intent alone do not pass.

Any complete-game/duration/content-volume claim is decomposed into authored objectives or puzzles, mechanic introductions and meaningful permutations/combinations, estimated uncoached solve time, and observed playtest time with tutorial/menus/retries/grind/replay/unbuilt assumptions separated; a short slice is labeled as a slice and cannot substantiate unbuilt hours.

A project-specific balance contract declared before final evidence covers representative archetypes, early/mid/late checkpoints, applicable power/challenge, unlock/choice cadence, failure recovery, option viability, and resource source/sink boundaries. A deterministic audit plus target-build transaction trace prove the implemented curve, exact costs/rewards, persistence, and exploit boundaries; a generic spreadsheet, one optimal autoplay, aggregate averages, or model-only PASS does not pass.

At least two separate clean-profile uncoached human target-build traces cover representative supported cohorts through early, mid, late, and failure/recovery or bottleneck states. The review judges goal clarity, reward relevance, grind/drought, fatigue, recovery, strategy viability, and the free path when monetization exists. The builder must fix routine arithmetic and transaction defects autonomously; the user is not the default tester, and simulation, designer play, autoplay, or theoretical duration cannot substitute for human pacing evidence.

A clean-profile independent raw target-build review covers current/starting progression, first reward, first meaningful choice, a purchased/unlocked consequence, and a locked/late state. In a recorded blind first-glance pass, neutrally named artifacts are shown before intended mappings, state labels, builder narration, spreadsheet knowledge, or the desired verdict; uncertainty and wrong guesses are preserved and later study cannot retroactively pass them. The reviewer can state what changed, what can be done next, what it costs or requires, what consequence the choice has, and what new decision the unlock creates. A localized text table, correct source/sink arithmetic, valid save transaction, level count, or solver/autoplay PASS cannot substitute for visual hierarchy, state change, reachable-goal cues, and meaningful choice communication.

A genre-aware difficulty contract declared before bulk content separates execution, cognition, time, resources, punishment, uncertainty, coordination and navigation/information load; maps taught skills into practice, combination/test, peaks/relief or player-selected risk; bounds novelty, rises, failure recovery and onboarding pressure; and proves every required beat in the exact target build. One monotonic scalar, HP/damage/cost inflation, grind, obscurity, travel, autoplay, or a designer-authored chart alone does not pass. Dynamic assistance preserves feedback, outcome and reward integrity; ranked play never uses hidden mid-match outcome steering.

At least two clean-profile uncoached human target-build sessions across representative genre experience judge challenge comprehension, actual skill use, novelty, peaks/relief or voluntary risk, failure attribution/retry, fatigue, fairness and any assistance/adaptation. The builder owns routine contract and implementation defects; simulation, autoplay, aggregate telemetry, designer play or one short opening cannot certify perceived pacing across an unobserved campaign/run/session.

An independent raw target-build review passes the main menu as an authored game-specific composition: the title is a deliberate wordmark or typographic system at runtime size; the icon/mark, background, hierarchy, controls, and copy belong together; redundant AI-marketing taglines and a generic kicker + huge default-font title + accent rule + explanatory sentence + stack of identical rectangles do not pass merely because they are aligned and themed.

Builder-owned raw target-build review of quiet, normal, dense interaction, peak VFX/contact, and result states proves production art integrity. Any material aim, trajectory, route, bounce, placement, area, or intent telegraph encodes the action's direction, contact/change, endpoint and validity through the selected shape/material/motion language; exact math in a raw debug-like Line2D/mesh is insufficient. Serialized Box/Cylinder/Sphere/CSG geometry remains blockout unless a documented minimalist language and gameplay-size review justify it; debug-looking quads, rectangles, cones, billboards or particles, mismatched panorama/character families, broken contact/depth, sparse repeated modules, and empty placeholder panels block release even when scene/import/performance audits pass.

A builder visual-versus-text inventory plus independent raw target-build review passes the gameplay HUD in quiet, normal, dense interaction, and peak-VFX states. Every persistent/contextual text zone has a keep/shorten/iconify/world-cue/remove rationale; repeated identical labeled rectangles and panels do not become finished communication by being aligned or localized; frequent telemetry and core-action state are recognizable through authored icons, shapes, meters, world cues, motion and concise accessible teaching without sentence reading. Objective copy is short and does not compete with contextual prompts; icons form one authored final-size family with non-color differentiation and accessible names/tooltips/first-use teaching; representative localization does not recreate long persistent captions. Compact panel bounds or clean styling alone do not pass excessive simultaneous reading load.

A project-specific network contract and separate-process target-build traces prove topology, supported transport/platform pairing, server authority, authenticated and rate-limited RPC surfaces, stable replication identities, convergence under declared latency/jitter/loss, hostile-input rejection, disconnect/reconnect recovery, dedicated-server behavior when promised, persistence idempotence when applicable, interest bounds, and declared client/tick/bandwidth capacity. One editor process, localhost success, node presence, or direct RPC calls do not pass.

A human multiplayer session uses at least two independently controlled target-build peers and the promised server topology. It reviews join/leave, moment-to-moment responsiveness, remote motion/action readability, correction severity, failure messaging, impairment behavior, and reconnect continuity. Builder bots and deterministic convergence traces remain required support but cannot certify social clarity, perceived fairness, or network feel.

A declared extraction ledger and target-build traces prove preparation, meaningful route/risk choice, loot acquisition, voluntary extraction, raid death/loss, secure-container and insurance boundaries, exactly-once settlement across retry/reconnect, durable stash reload, unauthorized/duplicate item rejection, and a bounded recovery path from bankruptcy. A combat sandbox with an exit marker or an abstract economy PASS is not an extraction loop.

Separate clean-profile uncoached target-build sessions prove that players understand what is at stake, can compare at least two viable route/loadout risks, consciously choose when to extract, understand death and settlement, recover after a meaningful loss, and can prepare the next raid without hidden designer narration. Simulated success rates cannot certify tension, greed, frustration, or recovery pacing.

An honestly scoped online production slice provides separately deployable client and authoritative server builds plus real service evidence for identity/session handling, durable idempotent transactions, zone/shard or interest ownership, capacity/load and soak budgets, health/metrics/log correlation, failure injection, backup restore, deployment rollback, configuration/secrets separation, abuse/moderation boundaries, and data/privacy lifecycle. A local mock backend, one host process, or a replicated demo cannot be called an MMO production slice.

An independent architecture/operations review verifies the actual trust boundaries, ownership of authoritative and durable data, service and zone failure model, capacity assumptions, deployment/rollback and restore evidence, privacy/moderation responsibilities, and the exact scope label. It explicitly rejects launch-scale or complete-MMO claims that rely on unbuilt or untested infrastructure.

A versioned save contract plus production-path target-build traces prove clean creation, exact round trip, recoverable interrupted/partial writes, corrupt-primary fallback without destroying the only copy, migration from every supported released version, duplicate-load/retry idempotence, scoped reset, and applicable cloud/device conflict. A successful FileAccess/JSON unit test, current-version-only load, or prose backup policy does not pass.

A declared device/action/accessibility contract and target-build traces prove every supported device can reach critical gameplay and emergency UI actions; remap/conflict/reset/persistence work; glyphs follow actual modality; hot-plug/focus recovery does not duplicate or leak input; local player ownership is isolated when applicable; and every advertised accessibility option changes behavior while preserving critical meaning. Input-map entries or settings labels alone do not pass.

An independent target-build review verifies clean first-use input, remapping/recovery, truthful focus and glyphs, and before/after effects of declared text/subtitle, motion/flash/shake, non-color, hold/toggle/timing, audio/caption, touch or assist options as applicable. It judges comprehension and comfort without turning unsupported features into claims; a structural checklist or builder self-review does not pass.

A project-specific AI/navigation contract and production traces prove perception boundaries/occlusion, legal state transitions, fair information access, route following, dynamic replan, unreachable/deleted-target recovery, crowd/deadlock behavior, attack telegraph/reaction budgets, pause/save lifecycle, off-screen cadence, and declared actor-capacity performance. A behavior tree, nav path, direct state call, or idle screenshot does not pass.

Independent raw target-build motion review confirms AI intent is legible before consequence, locomotion/contact matches navigation and visible collision, actors recover without jitter/stuck/deadlock, allies and crowds do not obstruct play unfairly, and higher difficulty changes declared behavior rather than reading hidden player state. Deterministic AI assertions cannot certify readability or fairness.

A versioned generator contract and target-build seed cohort prove deterministic same-seed topology, start/exit and required-objective reachability, lock/key/resource/recovery constraints, bounded retry/fallback, save/resume parity, declared distributions, generation budgets, and no dominant repeated layout above the project threshold. A few attractive seeds or a randomize call do not pass.

Uncoached human target-build runs across separate named seeds review route comprehension, meaningful decision variance, repeated room/encounter patterns, worst-seed fairness, pacing, visual/audio seams and whether surprising combinations remain recoverable. Seed count, topology hashes and distribution ranges cannot certify novelty or fun.

Builder-owned model and target-build traces prove authoritative fixed-step/event simulation, deterministic command ordering, exact resource/job transactions, pause and declared time-scale parity, congestion/reservation/deadlock recovery, save/load across completion boundaries, and declared late-game entity/job performance. A small idle map cannot substantiate production capacity or long-session correctness.

Uncoached human target-build sessions cover at least two viable openings, mid/late bottlenecks, mass control, alerts, maximum time scale, failure/comeback and completion. The review judges decision clarity, information hierarchy, workload, snowballing and recovery; deterministic economy/AI traces cannot certify strategy quality or fatigue.

A handling/physics contract and target-build traces prove comparable authoritative results across supported render caps, device-appropriate controls, checkpoint/lap direction and anti-cut rules, surface/contact behavior, collision and airborne/flip recovery, camera/occlusion restoration, full lap/result/restart and declared high-speed performance. VehicleBody presence or one successful lap does not pass.

Human target-build review on every supported primary device judges response, control near the limit, assist behavior, camera readability/motion comfort, surface and collision fairness, opponent contact, recovery and whether the course teaches speed safely. Physics numbers and autoplay cannot certify handling feel.

A combat authority contract and target-build traces prove press/hold/release and weapon/action state transitions, exact ammo/cooldown/reload/swap behavior, exactly-once hit/damage/status ordering, range/occlusion/collision/team/invulnerability boundaries, projectile lifetime, simultaneous outcomes, death/respawn/restart and dense-combat performance. A hit marker, animation or damage unit test alone does not pass.

Human target-build review on each primary aim modality judges response, sensitivity/dead-zone/assist, telegraph/reaction fairness, recoil/camera comfort, hit confirmation and damage cause, threat direction, time-to-kill/recovery, audio priority and HUD readability in dense combat. Arithmetic and bots cannot certify combat feel.

Versioned narrative data and target-build traces prove required branches and conditions/effects, stable IDs, skip equivalence and exactly-once effects, pause/focus/actor-loss interruption recovery, save/load before and after state-changing lines, replay/re-entry policy, representative localization/voice/subtitle timing, and clean return to gameplay. Reachable dialogue text alone does not pass.

Independent raw target-build review judges choice comprehension, wording/consequence match, pacing, repetition, emotional and spatial staging, subtitle/speaker/caption readability, long-locale behavior, skip/interruption recovery and gameplay handoff without designer narration. Graph validity cannot certify narrative experience.

Target-build traces with the promised simultaneous players prove distinct device-to-player ownership, join/leave and identical-controller handling, hot-plug/reconnect, pause/menu ownership, focus loss, cross-player input isolation, shared/split camera and per-player UI identity, completion/result/rematch and no one-device path secretly controlling all actors.

A real simultaneous human target-build session with the supported player/device count judges join clarity, player identity, camera framing, competition/cooperation readability, pause/disconnect recovery, fairness, result and rematch. Sequential builder control or bots do not certify a local multiplayer experience.

For every declared platform/store, exact release candidates and production-like install/update traces prove signing/package identity, clean first launch, update over an old save, offline/missing-SDK fallback, overlay/focus/suspend/resume, display/DPI/fullscreen/safe-area and input lifecycle, configured cloud/achievement/stat/leaderboard/entitlement retry behavior, crash/log/clean exit, and upload/store-side states. Export exit 0 alone does not pass.

A versioned mod/UGC manifest and target-build loader traces prove valid content, malformed/corrupt and oversized rejection, path traversal/protected-path collision prevention, dependency/load-order/version handling, bounded media decode, removed-mod save fallback, safe mode, diagnostics and rollback without partial registry/save mutation. Loading one friendly PCK/JSON file does not pass.

Independent security/architecture review verifies the actual trust tier, namespace and override boundaries, executable-code/native-library risk and explicit consent, size/decode limits, save dependency/uninstall behavior, rights/distribution/moderation path and honest absence of sandbox claims. Unknown downloaded payloads are never auto-executed.

A fixed-tick fighting simulation proves repeated seeded input scripts produce identical per-frame state, authoritative move phases align with authored hit/hurt boxes, buffered command boundaries and near-miss rejection work on supported devices, and applicable hit/block/whiff/trade/cancel/hitstop/round-reset cases resolve exactly once; render FPS caps, framework presence, and data files alone do not pass.

A recorded world/progression graph and real room playthrough prove required ability-gated routes, one-way escape states, save/respawn on both sides of gates, persistent collectibles/bosses/shortcuts, and return traversal without a soft lock; a passing abstract graph cannot substitute for authored collision/spawn/transition tests.

Decimal/integer curve evidence and target-build play prove the earn-purchase-production loop, declared short/long milestones, exact displayed/debited costs, bounded offline awards, duplicate-load idempotence, clock manipulation policy, numeric extremes, and save migration; per-frame label updates or a mathematically passing model alone do not pass.

Quest definitions, runtime state, and UI ownership are separated, and target-build tests prove accept/progress/complete/fail/branch/reload behavior, duplicate event rejection, exactly-once rewards including failure recovery, stable IDs/migration, and localized objective copy; signal connections or Resource presence alone do not pass.

The approved reference file/state/capture conditions and named deviations are recorded; the formal hierarchy is editor-visible in Godot scenes; same-resolution raw side-by-side, overlay, and diff artifacts plus representative locale/input/responsive captures receive region-level review. A low global pixel error or baked screenshot background alone does not pass.

A free-orbit third-person target proves camera-relative locomotion after 45-90 degree yaw, right-stick X/Y, declared zoom/recenter, camera-collision shortening/restoration, and pause/menu/focus-loss mouse-capture recovery; real InputEventMouseMotion must change yaw and pitch through a fixture containing the visible production HUD, plus target-build sensitivity review. Input-map presence or direct method calls do not pass, and this gate does not substitute for player-visibility evidence.

Measured HUD occupancy and rendered start/route views stay within a recorded gameplay-visibility budget; multi-height checks resolve all simultaneous camera-player occluders, camera-only proxies preserve open holes, cutaway/silhouette policy keeps both player and route readable, render/collision shells agree at tested openings, every mutated visual state fully restores, and the exact reported/highest-structure elevation view retains route contrast without a bright transparent veil/grid.

Before bulk level authoring, an independent gameplay-size rendered review passes one representative slice containing the hero, a mechanism in default/changed states, beacon/objective, structural and dressing decor, final-direction lighting/material response, and gameplay UI/tutorial feedback; asset counts, imports, isolated previews, sparse repeated rows, and temporary/default-looking art do not pass.

Quiet, dense, height/lift, and route-changing/occlusion states provide raw screenshots and same-frame hero-only masks that meet predeclared project thresholds for screen size, mean character/background separation, and local-edge separation, while independent review confirms a recognizable silhouette, readable mechanism/objective, and actionable route without tutorial-only highlighting.

A clean uncoached first-use trace proves the player causes movement, pickup, context interaction, mechanism state change, traversal of the changed route, height/lift use, beacon delivery, and restart/recovery; each transition has distinct feedback, safe pressure, and an unobstructed target/route. Text, narration, scripted demonstrations, or final completion alone do not pass.

Independent raw target-build review of start/teaching, typical puzzle, densest mechanism/decor, highest elevation, and objective/result frames confirms focal hierarchy, purposeful foreground/midground/background structure, landmarks, route rhythm, controlled repetition, intentional negative space, and HUD/world balance; sparse tile rows, default-white lost characters, and nominal asset variety do not pass.

Builder-owned exact target-build evidence proves fixed/high-angle 3D district or arena quality before owner/independent review: every contactable boundary has a visible urban/terrain cause and opening negative tests; block massing, primary/secondary landmarks, depth bands, view-corridor terminations and dominant negative space support declared decisions; functional zones use cause-response-consequence clusters rather than prop scatter; screen-filling modular families obey recorded multi-axis variation, adjacency and maximum visible-run budgets; architectural materials are assigned by zone/function/construction/age/story/adjacency with declared dominant/support/accent screen-area and rendered value/saturation envelopes; source texture/PBR plus facade/roof/trim structure survives; raw same-zone and cross-zone frames under exact gameplay lighting reject checkerboard/random flood fills; and normal-speed motion proves frame-rate-independent follow/look-ahead, safe framing, bounded pressure zoom, camera-volume/rail blending, multi-point obstruction handling and full restoration. A perimeter fence, repeated containers/cars/crates, duplicated backdrop buildings, flat per-instance hue cycling, 100% material coverage, hue counts, prop count, navmesh/scene validity, culling statistics, editor material/free-camera views or a polished still does not pass.

Builder-owned exact target-scene contract and target-build close-ups prove visual environment integrity independently from gameplay collision: every visible prop requiring occupancy has one or more local volumes transformed by its full final Godot Transform3D and checked pairwise with exact, reasoned, raw-artifact-backed intentional exemptions; semantic classes such as trees, rocks, bushes, vehicles and road debris keep their entire transformed support footprint on authored allowed render surfaces rather than merely placing their origin legally; camera-visible ground regions are sampled against final render-mesh triangles, not a broad floor collider, to reject holes, wrong top surfaces and exposed substrate; and signs, wires, poles, towers, awnings and facade-adjacent volumes satisfy authored vertical-clearance rules. The audit has zero errors and raw shipping-build occupancy, surface-ownership, ground-seam, clearance, detected-class before/fixed/rerun and overview states agree. Complete collision, alignment, boundary, navigation, origin or scene-serialization checks do not pass visible penetrations, fused props, roadway nature footprints or surface seams.

A versioned locale contract and target-build traces prove every required locale and fallback, plural branches, font/glyph coverage, placeholder preservation, live language switching, subtitle timing, directional/focus semantics when applicable, pseudolocalization, and dense/narrow overflow budgets. String-table presence or one wide screenshot does not pass.

An independent reviewer checks representative short, long, plural, subtitle, input-label, narrow and right-to-left states in the exact target build for meaning, hierarchy, truncation, shaping, focus order and culturally unsafe assumptions. Automated key coverage alone does not pass.

Pinned engine, export templates, dependencies, import inputs and build commands produce functionally identical clean target artifacts in at least two clean environments per declared preset; credentials remain external, warnings/errors are classified, dependency hashes/licenses are recorded, and an exact source revision can be rebuilt. One warm-worktree export or raw ZIP hash alone does not pass.

Independent release review confirms every addon/tool/native library has a pinned source and version, compatible license and notices, bounded update policy and no bundled secrets or unexplained binary drift.

A versioned replay contract proves record/playback parity at declared checkpoints, safe old/corrupt rejection or migration, external nondeterministic outcome capture, ghost collision isolation, seek/pause/speed behavior where supported, and target-build replay of representative short, long and failure sessions. Godot physics must not be claimed cross-machine deterministic without measured proof.

Independent target-build review confirms replay, ghost or spectator controls are discoverable, time/subject state is legible, camera transitions are safe, desync/corruption is explained without damaging progress, and the feature has actual player value rather than only a deterministic test harness.

Target-build traversal proves predeclared cell/chunk, memory, frame-time and loading budgets across ordinary travel, fast travel, boundary oscillation, teleport, save/load and missing/corrupt content; async requests do not synchronously stall, ownership unloads cleanly, navigation/physics/audio/VFX remain coherent, and large-world coordinates are enabled only from measured need.

Independent traversal review judges pop-in, landmark continuity, navigation clarity, repeated seams, missing ambience/actors and recovery after rapid travel; passing memory counters cannot hide an incoherent or visibly empty streamed world.

Exact Android/iOS candidates prove clean install/update, touch targets and gestures, safe areas/cutouts, orientation contract, keyboard/back navigation, pause/background/resume, interruption/audio focus, thermal and battery-aware performance, memory pressure, permission denial, offline state and store package/signing metadata on declared real-device tiers. Desktop emulation alone does not pass.

A real-device human session on the declared minimum and representative device tiers judges grip, reach, gesture conflict, text scale, heat, interruptions and sustained play comfort. Simulator screenshots and automated taps are supporting evidence only.

A versioned LiveOps contract and target-build traces prove schema validation, signed/environment-scoped configuration, safe bundled defaults, timeout/offline/malformed/stale fallback, staged rollout and rollback, bounded idempotent analytics queues, consent/opt-out/deletion behavior, forbidden-field filtering and no client secrets. A successful happy-path HTTP request does not pass.

Independent privacy/operations review verifies data minimization, retention and deletion, consent surfaces, environment separation, experiment guardrails, emergency rollback, observability and honest disclosure of third-party processors and untested backend scale.

The exact OpenXR target build proves startup/runtime fallback, tracked head and both supported controllers/hands, calibrated origin/height, locomotion/turn/recenter, boundary and pause recovery, interaction reach, stable frame timing, readable world-space UI and no required desktop-only input. Editor preview or mocked poses alone do not pass.

A real-headset human session judges scale, reach, locomotion, turning, acceleration, camera motion, text distance, handedness, seated/standing assumptions and discomfort over the declared session length. Automated pose traces cannot certify comfort.

Authorized platform evidence records the actual provider/port, SDK and devkit scope, package/signing identity, controller and user lifecycle, suspend/resume, storage/save, network/account/entitlement failure, performance and certification checklist status. Public Godot export success, invented proprietary requirements or an unlicensed compatibility claim do not pass.

Runtime/editor creator tools prove stable IDs and versioned schemas, bounded undo/redo transactions, dirty-state prompts, save/load/export/import round trips, invalid/cyclic/oversized content rejection, autosave/crash recovery, keyboard/controller/touch reachability as declared, preview/runtime parity and safe content namespaces. One happy-path editor demo does not pass.

An uncoached creator completes the declared author-publish-test-reopen task, understands selection and validation feedback, recovers from a mistake and can locate the resulting content without builder narration. Automation proves mechanics, not authoring usability.
The supported viewport matrix includes reference, near-square/short-height, extreme-narrow, and wide states as applicable, with no blocking overlap, detachment, clipping, or image distortion.

Required pointer/touch and keyboard/gamepad UI entry paths are exercised separately; initial focus is truthful; pointer-focus cleanup does not cancel BaseButton release/pressed behavior in the target Web build; and every required overflowing touch surface proves drag-induced scroll movement rather than relying on node presence.

The exact target build proves clean exit, controlled error, crash/relaunch, hang/watchdog, memory and renderer failure, corrupted settings, interrupted write and log-redaction states against a declared recovery/data-loss budget, with matching build/symbol identity, bounded breadcrumbs, safe mode and no duplicate durable effects. A forced test-runner shutdown or installed crash SDK alone does not pass.

An independent support/release review verifies that artifacts match the exact build, recovery and safe-mode UX are truthful and usable, diagnostics are actionable and privacy-bounded, and forced-quit diagnostics are not misclassified as organic crashes.

An authoritative exactly-once entitlement ledger proves purchase success, replayed delivery, pending, cancel, offline, acknowledgement retry, refund/revoke, restore, account mismatch and verification outage in the target store/build. Unverified client receipts, embedded secrets or duplicate grants block release.

An independent security/operations review confirms verification authority, product/account binding, idempotency, acknowledgement/consumption, restore/revocation, secret handling and truthful policy/SDK scope.

Builder-owned production-client evidence proves the exact account/cloud adapter, resolver and persistence path across guest start, sign-in/link callbacks, empty and conflicting cloud payloads, multi-device/offline reconciliation inputs, user switch/sign-out, provider failure responses and deletion requests with stable internal identity, per-user isolation, idempotent merge, preserved fallback and no silent overwrite or sensitive logging. Project-owned provider doubles or injected responses validate client behavior only; they do not certify the real provider.

Target-provider evidence on the unchanged candidate proves real guest/sign-in/link, empty and conflicting cloud, two-device/offline reconciliation, user switch/sign-out, service outage behavior and provider-confirmed deletion without cross-user contamination, silent overwrite or sensitive logging. A local SDK mock, deterministic resolver, production-shaped fixture or builder-owned callback replay cannot pass this gate.

An independent account/conflict UX review proves that provenance, user choice or safe deterministic merge, backup, switching, outage and deletion states are understandable and cannot silently discard or cross-contaminate progress.

Server-owned target evidence rejects hostile requests and proves tiered integrity handling, false-positive review, authenticated rate-limited reports, persistent mute/block, idempotent sanction/expiry, moderation outage and privacy deletion without client sanction authority or cross-user disclosure.

Independent security/operations review verifies proportional server authority, minimized evidence, abuse-resistant reporting, reversible false positives, appeal/review ownership, clear sanctions, safe outage behavior and honest platform/legal limitations.

Immutable source fixtures and the exact upgraded target prove clean upgrade, old save/replay/mod handling as promised, dependency replacement, declared client/server skew, rollback and explicit downgrade rejection with idempotent migrations, stable IDs and no unclassified data loss.

Independent release review confirms backups, migration coverage, behavioral/rendering/performance regressions, protocol/version window, dependency/licensing changes and a workable rollback rather than accepting an editor that merely opens.

Deterministic bounded target-build injection covers declared durable/asynchronous boundaries and control, interruption, timeout, duplicate, reordering, malformed, truncated, oversized, disk-full and permission failures without hangs, unhandled exceptions, duplicate effects, orphan work or unsafe partial state; minimized seeds become regressions.

The exact desktop candidate runs on declared real minimum and representative machines across renderer, resize/fullscreen, ultrawide, HiDPI, multi-display, alt-tab, monitor/controller hot-plug and low-VRAM states within frame/memory budgets, with valid materials, onscreen UI/window and recovered input/settings.

Human sessions on real minimum and representative desktop hardware judge moment-to-moment responsiveness, stutter, readability, display transitions, input/audio recovery and fallback settings. Simulated limits, averages or one development machine cannot certify the release matrix.

The exact candidate proves meaningful names/roles/states/values/actions, logical order, bounded live announcements, no focus traps, full promised non-pointer operation, non-color cues, captions and real behavioral effects for motion/timing assists across critical menu-to-result flows. A label, tree dump or enabled setting alone does not pass.

A human using the actual promised platform assistive technology completes representative critical flows and judges semantics, navigation, announcement load, recovery and cognitive/motor usability. Structural automation is supporting evidence and the commissioning user is not assigned routine defect discovery.

dimensions.description: Preserves the brief, platform, genre-specific intent, constraints, and requested scope.
Uses maintainable scenes, instances, resources, wrappers, ownership, and focused scripts.
Core behavior, movement reference frame, collisions, state transitions, objectives, failure, and restart work correctly.

Controls, input-modality-aware focus, camera axes/collision/capture recovery, feedback, pressure-safe interactive onboarding, semantic progression/navigation UI, glanceable icon-first gameplay telemetry, concise objectives/prompts, explained accessibility settings, readable compound controls, and recovery make the loop understandable.

The selected layered art direction is justified against user intent, gameplay scale, production feasibility and target constraints; semantic app/menu identity, composition, player and route visibility, cutaway/silhouette behavior and restoration, screen-space HUD occupancy and icon-family coherence, perspective-sensitive world geometry, motion, lighting, effects, and UI form a coherent game presentation.

Across the supported viewport matrix, composition remains attached, content fits or scrolls intentionally, focus/hover/scrollbar states remain visible without layout shift, image-bearing controls preserve intended aspect ratios under real Container layout, and localized compound/icon-only button visuals remain centered as complete groups inside their hit targets.

The sonic direction, SFX, music/ambience, mix, controls, provenance, repetition handling, target-build behavior, and human listening result are intentional and verified rather than generic placeholder audio.
The selected art route can scale to the declared content; asset sourcing/generation, provenance, family consistency, cleanup, import, wrapper scenes, and reimport behavior are production-appropriate.
Code/resources are focused, compatible, maintainable, and free from relevant errors or brittle shortcuts.
Measured performance, memory/loading behavior, and build size meet the case's explicit target budgets.
Commands, captures, reports, versions, seeds, clean-versus-seeded state provenance, independent reviewer context, and unverified limits are recorded reproducibly.
